title: Window Cleaning Service Call Intake Form
subtitle: Control access setup, exclusion, glass cleaning, equipment control, inspection, and release through verified identity, domain-specific observations, evidence, authorization, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original, workflow-complete window cleaning service call intake for windows, frames, anchors, ladders, lifts, ropes, tools, and exclusion zones. It connects work plan, access method, anchors, products, and site approval to present conditions, repeatable evidence, decisions, unresolved work, and the receiving party's handoff.
use_case: Use when a window-cleaning service coordinator must triage and route a new window cleaning request without promising scope before site, asset, hazard, access, and authorization facts are known.

sections.title: Window Cleaning intake exception, containment, and escalation
sections.guidance: Make the trigger, immediate protection, decision owner, deadline, and dispatch restriction reconstructable.

blocks.label: Window Cleaning exception and stop-work indicators
items: Anchor, tieback, davit, roof, parapet, or building information unavailable
Required fall protection, rescue, communication, or competent review unavailable
Ladder, lift, scaffold, rope, harness, connector, or tool fails inspection
Wind, storm, lightning, ice, heat, visibility, or wet-surface condition unsafe
Electrical conductor, fragile roof, skylight, edge, or facade hazard uncontrolled
Pedestrian, occupant, vehicle, doorway, or lower-level exclusion cannot be maintained
Glass is cracked, loose, heat-stressed, coated, tinted, or incompatible with the method
Falling-object, water, hose, chemical, or equipment movement cannot be controlled
Facade access requires a method or height beyond the approved plan
Technician reports fatigue, medical, communication, or rescue-readiness concern
blocks.guidance: Select the observed condition; do not use a generic exception when the actual trigger is known.

sections.title: Window Cleaning service call intake closeout and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Close only when outcome, remaining limitation, next action, evidence, and receiving ownership agree.

blocks.label: Remaining action and follow-up register

blocks.guidance: This window cleaning service call intake is an operational record, not a substitute for applicable law, licensing, product labeling, manufacturer instructions, site policy, safety requirements, or professional judgment. Stop affected work, access, application, operation, testing, or release when anchorage, access equipment, fall protection, rescue, weather, electrical, public exclusion, facade, glass, or drop-zone condition is uncertain. A access and fall-protection supervisor must review the exception, authorize the controlling decision, and preserve its evidence before closeout.
